children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions received a third dealer order adding two RIO Mini systems and one AVA to RAD's national dealer relationship.
RAD received a third order from a recently signed national dealer for two RIO Mini units and one AVA to serve a North Carolina construction equipment company.
The latest order expands the dealer's RAD product mix to four solutions: RIO 360, ROSA, RIO Mini and AVA, across three distinct end-user settings.
AVA provides credential verification and vehicle access control at entry points; RIO Mini extends coverage where permanent power or fixed infrastructure is unavailable.
Order announced ~seven weeks after the dealer's first order, reflecting accelerating dealer adoption and cross-selling across RAD's portfolio.
